group.title: Warehouse stock count
group.passage:
Quarterly stock count — Warehouse B

The count will take place on Friday from 1 to 5 p.m. During this period, routine material issues and receipts will pause. Production teams should collect materials for the afternoon by noon.

Urgent requests may be authorized by the warehouse manager. If a transaction is approved during the count, record it on the temporary movement sheet and give a copy to the counting team. Do not rely on a verbal message alone.

Counting pairs will compare physical quantities with the stock list. Differences should be recorded and checked a second time before any inventory adjustment is made. Damaged stock must be counted separately rather than omitted.
group.passageZh:
季度盤點——B 倉庫

盤點將於星期五下午一點至五點進行，期間暫停一般物料領用與收貨。生產團隊最遲應在中午領取下午需要的材料。

緊急需求可由倉庫經理核准。若盤點期間核准一筆出入庫，須記錄於臨時異動表，並交一份副本給盤點團隊，不能只靠口頭傳達。

兩人一組的盤點人員將比對實際數量與庫存清單。差異應先記錄並二次查核，再調整庫存紀錄。受損庫存必須另行計數，不能漏列。
